audience.detail: README says free to start with $4/month Premium, share with friends, App Store and Google Play plus public marketing site.

assessment.data_detail: Collects email, name and birthday on signup and takes $4/month Premium subscriptions via Stripe, with no privacy policy or terms found.

deployment.detail: vercel.json and eas.json plus app.json exist for web and mobile, but no CI, empty EAS submit block and no production env setup.

assessment.headline: Recipe app is not ready to sell: paid fonts, stock photo, music and missing privacy terms block launch.

issues.ai_prompt: In server/index.js and src/App.js the app collects email/name/birthday and Stripe subscriptions but there are no privacy or terms pages. Add Privacy Policy and Terms screens/pages covering data collected, Stripe payments, subscriptions, and contact, link them in web/index.html, in the Expo app settings/about screen, and for App Store Connect privacy URL before submission.
issues.explain: You collect personal data and take payments but have no privacy policy or terms. Stores will reject you and users have no notice.
issues.recommendation: Add Privacy Policy and Terms pages, link them in app and on recipebox.example, and add store privacy URLs.
issues.title: No privacy policy or terms for paid app

issues.ai_prompt: Check assets/hero-shutterstock_2231987.jpg used in src/App.js line 13. Confirm if a Shutterstock standard or extended licence was purchased for in-app mobile use, replace with a licensed or own image if not, buy the correct licence, and add proof to CREDITS.md.
issues.explain: File name shows a Shutterstock image used as the app hero. Without a paid licence this is a takedown risk.
issues.recommendation: Buy the right Shutterstock licence or replace the image and record it in CREDITS.md.
issues.title: Shutterstock hero image needs paid licence

issues.ai_prompt: Check assets/brand/Gotham-Bold.otf loaded via expo-font in src/App.js line 8. Gotham is a paid commercial font - confirm a mobile app embedding licence was purchased, or replace with an open font like Inter from Google Fonts, remove the .otf if unlicensed, and document in CREDITS.md.
issues.explain: Gotham is a paid font that is bundled in the app. Embedding it needs a purchased licence.
issues.recommendation: Prove the font licence or swap to a free font and remove the .otf.
issues.title: Paid Gotham font bundled without proof

issues.ai_prompt: Check assets/music/theme-song.mp3 auto-played in src/App.js line 9 via expo-av. Identify composer/source, confirm you have sync and mobile-app rights for it, add credit and licence to CREDITS.md, or replace with a royalty-free track and add a mute toggle instead of autoplay.
issues.explain: App auto-plays a theme song with no credit. Music needs clear rights for store apps.
issues.recommendation: Prove music rights or replace with royalty-free music and add mute control.
issues.title: Theme music rights unknown plus autoplay

issues.ai_prompt: In web/index.html line 2 the site loads https://use.typekit.net/xyz1abc.css (Adobe Fonts). In Adobe Fonts dashboard verify the kit ID, add recipebox.example and Vercel preview domains to allowed domains, confirm the subscription covers this public use, and add fallback fonts if the kit fails.
issues.explain: Marketing site uses a paid Adobe Fonts kit. Wrong kit or domain will break fonts or breach terms.
issues.recommendation: Verify Adobe Fonts kit, allowed domains and active subscription.
issues.title: Adobe Fonts kit needs licence check

issues.ai_prompt: In eas.json and app.json complete the store release setup: add EAS submit fields for ios bundleIdentifier com.example.recipebox and android package, add versioning, privacyPolicyUrl, and icons/splash confirmation, then test `eas build -p ios`, `eas build -p android` and `eas submit`.
issues.explain: EAS build and submit blocks are minimal with no store metadata. You cannot ship updates reliably yet.
issues.recommendation: Fill out EAS submit config, store privacy URLs, and test builds.
issues.title: App Store release setup is incomplete

issues.ai_prompt: Review assets/icons/apple-pay-logo.png shown in src/App.js line 15 and @stripe/stripe-react-native usage. Follow Apple Pay brand guidelines for logo size/clear space, only show it when Apple Pay is actually available, and remove or replace the image if not using Apple Pay.
issues.explain: Apple logos have strict display rules. Misuse can cause App Store review issues.
issues.recommendation: Check Apple Pay guidelines and only show logo when Apple Pay works.
issues.title: Apple Pay logo must follow brand rules

issues.ai_prompt: In vercel.json and server/index.js finish production deploy: confirm Vercel outputDirectory web is correct, add separate preview/production env vars for STRIPE_SECRET_KEY and EXPO_PUBLIC_STRIPE_KEY in Vercel dashboard (never commit them), enforce HTTPS, and document deploy steps in README.md.
issues.explain: Vercel config exists but there is no CI or documented env handling for Stripe keys and backend hosting.
issues.recommendation: Set Stripe keys in Vercel/host env, confirm backend host, and add deploy docs.
issues.title: Production env and backend hosting unclear

issues.ai_prompt: Add a LICENSE file at repo root choosing a licence (e.g. Proprietary - All rights reserved if closed paid app), and check package.json dependencies especially react-native-pdf-lib and Stripe SDKs for copyleft terms. Add third-party notices to CREDITS.md.
issues.explain: No LICENSE file means no one else may legally reuse the code, and stores and clients often require one.
issues.recommendation: Add a LICENSE file and list open-source credits in CREDITS.md.
issues.title: No project licence file

issues.ai_prompt: In web/index.html line 3 the image uses https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1495521821757-a1efb6729352 directly. Replace hotlink with a downloaded copy with Unsplash credit or keep hotlink per Unsplash API rules, add photographer credit to CREDITS.md, and check food-1.png source the same way.
issues.explain: Unsplash images are free but need correct use and credit to avoid disputes.
issues.recommendation: Confirm Unsplash terms, add photographer credit to CREDITS.md.
issues.title: Confirm Unsplash photo credit

issues.ai_prompt: Create CREDITS.md at the project root. List every image, icon set, font, sound and video in the project with where it came from and its licence (write 'own work' for ones I made). Ask me about any you cannot tell.
issues.explain: The project ships 7 media files but no CREDITS or NOTICE file says where they came from, so nobody can show you had permission.
issues.recommendation: Add CREDITS.md listing each image, font, icon set and sound with its source and licence.
issues.title: No credits file for images, fonts or sounds

license.detail: No LICENSE file and no declared licence found in checks.

mobile.detail: package.json uses expo and react-native, app.json sets iOS and Android IDs, eas.json has EAS build config.

strengths: Secrets use env vars, not hard-coded keys
Deploy intents are clear: Vercel site plus EAS mobile builds
Business model is stated upfront in README
assessment.summary: Recipe Box is an Expo iPhone/Android app plus Vercel marketing site with $4/month Premium via Stripe. It collects names, emails and birthdays for signups. Paid Gotham font, Shutterstock hero, theme music, Adobe Fonts and missing privacy terms must be fixed before App Store launch.
